capabilities: Open notes as standalone, draggable, resizable OS-level popout windows
Cycle window states between floating, always-on-top pinned, and Windows desktop widget
Edit notes with native Live Preview and a rich-text toolbar (lists, checkboxes, strikethrough, image insertion)
Manage all stickies from a hub with search, previews, and restore-to-main-window
Style notes with seven skeuomorphic paper skins and dark-mode support
extras: Desktop Widget mode (embedding into the Windows shell via Progman) is Windows-only; manual installation from GitHub Releases is described; listed as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian notes live inside panes of the main window, so users who want quick thoughts permanently visible on the desktop while working in other apps have no built-in way to do that.
summary: Sticky-note plugin that opens notes as always-on-top, floating OS-level popout windows with Live Preview editing, paper skins, and a notes hub.
